en.greeting: Hello, you've reached reception. How can I help you?
en.greeting_known: Hello %s, this is your Prism assistant. I'm listening.

en.phrase_transfer_now: All right, I'll transfer you now.
en.phrase_connecting: %s has accepted the call. I'll connect you now.
en.phrase_still_there: Are you still on the line?
en.phrase_not_understood: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you repeat it?
en.phrase_unknown_contact: I'm sorry, I can't reach %s. May I take a message?
en.phrase_announce: Hello, I have %s on the line about: %s. Would you like to take the call?
en.phrase_outbound_opening: Hello, I'm calling on behalf of the company.
en.phrase_announce_name: Hello, I have %s on the line for you. Would you like to take the call?
en.phrase_announce_unknown: Hello, a caller is waiting for you. Would you like to take the call?
en.phrase_recipient_accept: All right, I'll connect the caller.
en.phrase_recipient_decline: Understood, I'll let the caller know.
